purpose: Run a small exact-coordinate PEMS screen for Mamba-2, MambaTS, and their AutoCon representation-learning counterparts across short and long horizons.
research_question: Under identical PEMS windows, normalization, optimizer, and budget, does the MambaTS patch/variable-scan inductive bias preserve the Mamba-2 forecasting loss and does AutoCon change that comparison?
evidence_boundary: Exploratory validation-only screen. Test windows remain withheld; one seed per coordinate is a debugging and direction-finding result, not a publication-level ranking.
claim_boundary: Use exact-coordinate validation deltas to find failure modes and candidates. Do not claim generalization, statistical significance, graph-aware forecasting, or end-to-end speed from this screen.

required_before_launch: review the PEMS array hash and feature-axis contract
verify the active mamba environment and CUDA Mamba-1/Mamba-2 kernels
confirm all models use the same train/validation split, MeanStd normalization, and optimizer budget
confirm AutoCon representations use only observed windows and training-derived objective statistics
keep test metrics withheld during selection and repeat promising coordinates with fresh seeds

prelaunch_gates: review the PEMS array hash and feature-axis contract
verify the active mamba environment and CUDA Mamba-1/Mamba-2 kernels
confirm all models use the same train/validation split, MeanStd normalization, and optimizer budget
confirm AutoCon representations use only observed windows and training-derived objective statistics
keep test metrics withheld during selection and repeat promising coordinates with fresh seeds

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, model arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Retain source hashes, plan/config hashes, manifests, validation trajectories, relation telemetry, and resource records. Test metrics remain withheld.

phases.name: pems_mamba_ts_paired_h12_h96
phases.purpose: Exact-coordinate paired screen for Mamba-2, MambaTS, and their AutoCon variants across four PEMS arrays and two horizons.

comparison_contract.interpretation: Use exact paired deltas within each dataset, horizon, and seed. Time windows and channels are not independent replicates; no graph topology is used. Plain versus AutoCon comparisons are objective ablations, not independent model families.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This screen can expose dataset and horizon dependence for a later confirmation matrix, but cannot establish a final ranking, non-inferiority, generalization, or speed claim.

stopping_rules: This draft may run only through the frozen exploratory launcher with skip_test=true; a confirmation launch still requires a separate human-approved sidecar.
If any PEMS hash, feature index, source snapshot, config hash, or phase artifact changes, stop and regenerate the plan rather than merging rows.
Do not use test metrics to select MambaTS patch geometry, AutoCon lambda, or the final model.
If an AutoCon arm has missing representation or objective telemetry, treat that cell as a failed contract rather than imputing a value.
A favorable PEMS validation pattern is exploratory and requires fresh seeds, longer horizons, test release, matched resource measurement, and a separately reviewed confirmation plan.
